Markets.title: India bonds give up marginal opening gains as profit booking takes over
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds fell from early gains due to profit-taking by traders and a sharp decline in the rupee. Investors are now focused on the Reserve Bank of India's upcoming policy decision on December 4.

Markets.title: Rupee retreats, Goldman calls it a 'port of stability' in AI storm
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee retreated from a seven-month high due to corporate dollar buying after early gains pushed it into overbought territory. Despite this dip, the currency is on track for a monthly gain of over 2% and remains stable compared to other major currencies amid strong foreign investment.

Markets.title: The great Indian stock market comeback. Can the rally sustain and what should investors do?
Markets.summary: Indian equities surged 9.7% over eight sessions through November 12, reversing months of underperformance driven by foreign outflows and domestic pressures. This recovery was aided by a global tech sell-off as US artificial intelligence stocks dropped due to regulatory fears and political shifts.

Markets.summary: Global markets are focusing on five key triggers this week, including Black Friday retail sales and European Central Bank leadership changes. Investors are also monitoring Asian inflation data, South Korea's interest rate decision, and overall business activity.

Markets.title: Why is SanDisk stock falling? 5 factors weighing on shares
Markets.summary: SanDisk shares plummeted during a broad semiconductor sell-off driven by falling NAND price forecasts and weaker storage orders from Chinese cloud companies. Additional concerns regarding artificial intelligence spending have caused the stock to lose more than half its value over thirty trading sessions.

Markets.title: Milky Mist gains 5% on JM Financial's bullish call, up 140% from IPO price
Markets.summary: Milky Mist shares rose 5 percent following a bullish recommendation from JM Financial. The stock has increased 142 percent from its August IPO price of 140 rupees.

Data & Insights.summary: According to HSBC's Flash India Purchasing Managers' Index, India's private sector maintained steady growth in November. Demand improved at the fastest pace since June.

Data & Insights.summary: Over the past five years, Indian women have increased their participation in both low-risk bank deposits and high-risk equity funds. Despite this growth, achieving overall gender parity in investing remains a distant goal.

Data & Insights.summary: Food inflation in India has more than doubled since April due to soaring prices. The cost increases are primarily driven by everyday protein sources, including milk, pulses, meats, and eggs.

Data & Insights.summary: Gold prices have dropped below $4,000 per ounce due to rising US interest rates, higher bond yields, and a stronger dollar. Analysts at StoneX warn that bullion could slide further to key support levels of $3,600 and $3,500.

Data & Insights.title: The El Niño polycrisis: How a severe drought is squeezing Indian farms, ethanol plants and your kitchen budget
Data & Insights.summary: Deficit rainfall caused by El Niño has reduced water reservoirs and slowed winter crop planting across India. This agricultural strain is shrinking food supplies and driving up household food inflation.

India.title: 'Can't Come To Us For Every Violation': Top Court On Plea Over 100-Year-Old Mosque
India.summary: The Supreme Court refused to hear a contempt petition regarding the alleged violation of an order protecting a 100-year-old mosque. India.title: SIDBI Recruitment 2026: 68 Officer Vacancies Announced, Apply By December 11
